prior_overlap: Old RAEV2_DISTRIBUTIONAL_GATE_GUIDANCE section6 cited Learn to Guide energy-kernel mechanism; this is formal deep reading, not a new-discovery claim.
math_check: learn_to_guide/gaussian_consistency_check.py and .json; one deterministic scalar Gaussian calculation, no random draws or performance claim.
important_boundaries: Exact original-X self-consistency fails data processing in nondegenerate Gaussian corruption with an X-independent reverse kernel; approximate training utility is retained.
Finite-step posterior-mean substitution loses conditional covariance; exact PFODE may repair marginals deterministically; no new variance-restoration arm proposed.
Learned marginal-matching schedule differs from X-G regression and full-rollout endpoint energy gate.
Teacher-marginal single-step pushforward is not the current rollout marginal.
Learn ImageNet64 FID improves >5% against listed LIG, but training/selection/amortized cost not closed.
Adversarial main-table alignment/preference gains do not constitute FID improvement.
